findings.text: The node's landing contract states "Your done-when names no artifact, so this node writes no figure and no evidence prose outside the landing fragment, which is always permitted", yet the node wrote this figure (commit 83a7d9db6) and embedded it in the fragment at docs/evidence/fragments/scoring-should-stop-a-promotion/a-tracked-landing-write-restores-under-a-held-lock.html. The same dispatch lists the figure directory in FENCE - SCOPE, so its two clauses contradict each other; the figure is docs-only and harms nothing at runtime, but a spec-exact node should not have produced it, and the contradiction between the granted write path and the contract clause is a dispatch defect worth resolving before the next doc node.

The landed SVG is not the revision its own review inspected. figure-review.log (run dir, 19:20) records the accepted render at sha256 c1bbe4ab8acf96624227c8757f8b5fc5615b9762838427bc6a248fdab10f0148, but the file at reviewed head 99e8c506 hashes b8e6b55974c8dd2967330b0c0ac9fd1574b237c7faa3685ecf4dab8a9f66a88f: commit 99e8c5063 rewrote the non-rendered <desc> (line 4) and this drawn label (line 47) from "git cat-file blob HEAD:<path>" to "git show HEAD:<path>" after the accepted render. The edit only shortens a drawn string and rewords a description that is not painted, so the accepted layout is not invalidated and no collision is introduced, but the landed figure was never rendered and looked at, which the figure mandate requires of the revision that ships.
